mapper.select: SELECT FROM prompt_template WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM prompt_template WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_template (business_id, prompt_key, agent_scope, scene, version, status, template_content, variables_schema, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{promptKey}, #{agentScope}, #{scene}, #{version}, 'DRAFT', #{templateContent}, #{variablesSchema}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_template SET status = 'RETIRED' WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE prompt_template SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_execution (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, invocation_id, agent_id, scene, prompt_template_id, prompt_version, rendered_prompt, variables_snapshot) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{invocationId}, #{agentId}, #{scene}, #{templateId}, #{templateVersion}, #{renderedPrompt}, #{variablesSnapshot})
